probe.description: a TypeScript script outside the checkout opens a fresh database with SqliteRepositoryStore.open from packages/repository-store/src/store.ts at productBase, reads engine settings through a second bun:sqlite connection, then closes the store and reads the journal mode again; its output is recorded verbatim

notes: synchronous, wal_autocheckpoint and compile options are read on the second connection: they are this SQLite build's defaults, which the store does not override
compileOptions is filtered to synchronous, WAL, threading, journal and selected extension options
journalModeAfterClose shows the store returning the file to DELETE mode on close
